summary: Nethermind 实测 frame transaction 的验证预算：在客户端加入“处理区块时暂停验证”的保护后，MAX_VERIFY_GAS 提到 300k 可行，这正是隐私转账和后量子账户需要的量级。Trail of Bits 发布 Binance 事件后的签名系统四步指南，强调 7702 委托应按管理员权限对待。Magicians 出现代币层的 Protected Accounts 提案。Francesco 和 Barnabé 讨论 gas 重新定价的真实影响。

items.topic: EIP-8141 的验证预算能有多大：内存池 DoS 基准测试
items.title: ethresear.ch：EIP-8141 验证预算的内存池 DoS 基准
items.note: 06:26 发布（Nethermind 的 Stefano De Angelis、Daniil Ankushin、Manuel Arto）。frame transaction 的签名检查是 VERIFY 帧里的任意 EVM 代码，节点入池前要模拟验证前缀；如果验证失败，没人为这部分计算付费，构成 DoS 向量。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: a mempool DoS benchmark for the EIP-8141 validation budget
items.note_en: Posted at 06:26 by Stefano De Angelis, Daniil Ankushin and Manuel Arto of Nethermind. In a frame transaction the signature check is arbitrary EVM code in a VERIFY frame, and a node must simulate the validation prefix before admitting the transaction. If validation fails, nobody pays for that work, which is a DoS vector.

items.topic: Binance 之后：签名系统和账户层防护
items.title: Trail of Bits：Binance 之后，检查你的签名系统能批准什么
items.note: （美国时间 11-06 发布，Trail of Bits 发布推文 00:53）。核心观点：有权请求签名的服务器被攻破，不需要导出私钥也能滥用私钥。7702 委托相当于钱包签了一条常设指令“账户被调用时用这段代码”，在用钱包私钥修改或清除之前一直有效，所以首次盗窃之后存入的资金也被转走。四步建议：减少对签名基础设施的访问；把委托当作管理员权限；即使签名被攻破也要限制损失；监控钱包权限变化。文章还提醒，7702 授权不在普通 calldata 里，会话密钥、恢复路径、Safe 模块、ERC-4337 UserOp 也都要纳入监控。
items.title_en: Trail of Bits: after Binance, check what your signing systems can approve
items.note_en: (published 11-06 US time; Trail of Bits announcement post at 00:53). The core point: if a server allowed to request signatures is compromised, a key can be misused without ever being extracted. A 7702 delegation is like the wallet signing a standing instruction, "use this code when my account is called", which stays in place until changed or cleared with the wallet's key, so funds deposited after the first theft were moved too. Four recommendations: reduce access to signing infrastructure; treat delegation as an administrative privilege; limit the damage even if signing is compromised; monitor changes in wallet authority. The post also notes that 7702 authorizations sit outside ordinary calldata, and that session keys, recovery paths, Safe modules and ERC-4337 UserOps all need monitoring too.
items.topic_en: After Binance: signing systems and account-level protection

items.title: Magicians：ERC 草案 Protected Accounts for Fungible Tokens
items.note: 14:28 开帖。ERC-20 的可选“保护”标记：小额转账即时，超过限额的转账排队，可由预先登记的备用钱包取消；“stress”操作取消所有排队转账、把余额转到备用钱包并锁定一段预设时间（调用者不能自选时长），也能对付胁迫。超限的 `transferFrom` 直接 revert，路由和借贷协议不会被骗。参考实现是 Base Sepolia 上的 1:1 USDC 包装（pUSDC），在 ETHGlobal Mumbai 完成。开启保护即时生效，削弱保护（关闭、提高限额、缩短等待、换备用钱包）要等持有者自己设定的延迟。
items.title_en: Magicians: draft ERC, Protected Accounts for Fungible Tokens
items.note_en: Opened at 14:28. An optional "protected" flag for ERC-20s: small transfers are instant, transfers above the limit are queued and can be cancelled by a pre-registered backup wallet. A "stress" action cancels all pending transfers and moves the balance to the backup, locked for a preset duration the caller cannot choose, which also helps against coercion. Over-limit `transferFrom` calls revert, so routers and lending protocols cannot be fooled. The reference implementation is a 1:1 USDC wrapper (pUSDC) on Base Sepolia, built at ETHGlobal Mumbai. Turning protection on is instant; weakening it (turning it off, raising the limit, shortening the wait, changing the backup) waits for a delay the holder chooses.

summary_en: Nethermind measured the frame transaction validation budget: once clients pause validation while processing a block, raising MAX_VERIFY_GAS to 300k is workable, which is the range private transfers and post-quantum accounts need. Trail of Bits published a four-step guide for signing systems after the Binance incident, stressing that 7702 delegations should be treated as admin privileges. A token-level Protected Accounts proposal appeared on Magicians. Francesco and Barnabé discussed what gas repricing really does.
